Select the option that is related to the third word in the same way as the second word is related to the first word.

questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

 
• Entomology : Insect → Entomology is the study of insects.

Similarly,

 
• Ichthyology : ? → Ichthyology is the branch of zoology devoted to the study of fish.

Hence, '**Fish**' is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Select the number from among the given options that can replace the question mark (?) in the following series.

6, 8, 20, 66, ?
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

6 × 1 + 2 = 6 + 2 = 8

8 × 2 + 4 = 16 + 4 = 20

20 × 3 + 6 = 60 + 6 = 66

66 × 4 + 8 = 264 + 8 = 272

Hence, '**272**' is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

1. Some flowers are chemicals.

2. Some chemicals are herbs.

**Conclusions:**

I. No flower is a herb.

II. Some flowers are herbs.

options.text: Either conclusion I or II follows
Both conclusions I and II follows

questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/59ad67883b02e87e11bf512ab79e9a86b02a92479e449fdd2d6d30f24db52dff.png] 

Conclusions:

I. No flower is a herb. → Do not follow (As, there is no definite relation between flower and herb. Hence, false)

II. Some flowers are herbs. → Do not follow (As, there is no definite relation between flower and herb. Hence, false)

Conclusion I and II are complementary statements. 

Therefore, either I or II follows.

Hence,** Either conclusion I or II follows**.

questions.question: In a class of 75 students, 40 students participate in Cricket, 28 students participate in Hockey, and 12 students participate in both Cricket and Hockey, whereas 19 students do not participate in any of the two sports. How many students participate only in Hockey?
questions.solution:
In a class of 75 students.

19 students do not participate in any of the two sports. 

 
• Students who participate in any of the two sports or both the sports = 75 - 19 = 56

12 students participate in both Cricket and Hockey.

40 students participate in Cricket.</

questions.question:
Select the option that is related to the third number in the same way as the second number is related to the first number.

154 : 10 :: 261 : ?
questions.solution:
**Logic: **Sum of the digits of 1st number = 2nd number

The logic followed here is:

 
• 154 : 10 → 1 + 5 + 4 = 10

Similarly,

 
• 261 : ? → 2 + 6 + 1 = 9

Hence, '**9**' is the correct answer.
